modes.latch: a plate turns ON when stepped on (player or boulder) and stays ON; saved
modes.toggle: touching a crystal (face it + A) flips it and every id in toggles; saved
modes.hold: ON only while something stands on it; not saved

fields.on: list of switch ids that are ON

solved_when: every gate open (channels A and B complete)
on_solved: gates stay open on reload (state saved)
reset: never resets once solved; before that the state persists across exits

rules: Gate A opens once BOTH corner plates have been stepped on (latching). Resonance crystals: touching a crystal toggles it and the crystals linked to it (L<->M<->R). Gate B opens when all three glow. Middle starts lit; touching it first makes things worse. Helper trainers watch the band.
solution: Step on pA1 and pA2 -> gate A opens. Touch L then R (M stays lit) -> gate B opens. Master waits on the dais.
